source: Previously committed whole-box/whole-convex-domain conflict certificates, not a new geometric approximation.
group_truth: Original mandatory part A selects exactly one domain overall. A sum over a subset of its flags is therefore0 or1. Equating that sum to the new Boolean makes the group flag exactly the disjunction of those original domain choices.
exclusion_truth: Original part B also selects at most one listed domain. AtMostOne(group_flag, conflicting B flags) is therefore exactly the conjunction of pairwise group/B exclusions. If every B domain conflicts, not(group_flag AND queryB_active) is identical. A one-row A group directly uses that original domain flag.
